AC amendment (gap G2): pin the rg regex with word-boundary anchoring to avoid matching successor symbols like 'bridge_state_v2'. Use:
`rg -w 'bridge_state|prev_snapshot|mapping\.json'`
The -w flag enforces whole-word matching. mapping\.json's dot is regex-escaped so 'mapping.json' matches literally but not 'mapping_json'. Sub-agent MUST use this exact pattern when building the inventory.
